title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance Towing Schedule: Included Distance, Overage Rate and Destination
content:
## Towing figures by Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan

Each plan states the towing miles included in one callout, the price of each towing mile beyond that
included distance, and where the vehicle may be towed to.

| Plan | Towing miles included in one callout | Price of each mile beyond the included distance (USD) | Where the vehicle may be towed to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | 10 | 5.50 | the nearest suitable workshop |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | 25 | 4.95 | a workshop in the operator network |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | 100 | 3.95 | a destination of the member's choosing |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | 75 | 4.25 | a workshop in the operator network |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | 100 | 3.50 | a destination of the member's choosing |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | 250 | 3.25 | a destination of the member's choosing |

### The same schedule read by destination

The member's own choice of destination is carried by Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover, Keyturn Roadside
Fleet Cover and Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover. A workshop in the operator network is the
destination on Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, and the nearest suitable
workshop on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover.

Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover carries both the longest included distance, at 250 miles, and the
lowest price for each further mile, at USD 3.25; Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover carries the shortest
included distance, at 10 miles, and the highest price for each further mile, at USD 5.50. Keyturn
Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover carry the same included distance of 100 miles at
USD 3.95 and USD 3.50 a further mile respectively, and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover 75 miles at USD 4.25.
